as.sfi_deduplication_instructions: Merge candidates only when they represent the same source-visible curriculum item in the same grade/topic/sub-topic/unit context or are duplicate fragments caused by page/table continuation. Do not merge across P1, P2, and P3 merely because wording or unit numbers repeat. Do not merge different units that share the same number, such as Unit 1 in different grades. Keep repeated topic and sub-topic labels distinct when their grade or parent topic context differs.
as.sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract Academic Standards SFIs only from Section 6 syllabus-unit content. Treat source-visible Grade/P1-P3, Topic Area, Sub-Topic Area, and Unit labels as Standard Grouping SFIs. Treat grade-level key competences, Key Unit Competence statements, and Learning Objectives under Knowledge and Understanding, Skills, and Attitudes and Values as Standard SFIs. Do not extract Content, Learning Activities, Links to other subjects, Assessment criteria, Teaching/learning aids, examples, Number of Periods, front matter, pedagogy, resources, assessment approach, acknowledgements, references, or weekly time allocation as SFIs. Do not infer absent parent labels. Preserve source-visible wording and table row/header evidence.
as.sfi_has_child_instructions: Resolve direct hasChild parents using the source hierarchy: StandardsFramework root -> Grade -> Topic Area -> Sub-Topic Area -> Unit. Grade Key Competence attaches to Grade. Key Unit Competence attaches to Unit. Knowledge Objective, Skills Objective, and Attitudes and Values Objective attach to the Key Unit Competence from the same unit. Prefer source-visible table/section context, source order, shared window/segment/table evidence, and canonical scope evidence. Do not choose parents by repeated text or unit number alone. Use an unresolved root fallback only when no supplied SFI parent is source-supported.

statement_type_policy.description: Use for source-visible lower-primary grade/stage groupings such as P1 Mathematics, P2 Mathematics, P3 Mathematics, Primary One, Primary Two, or Primary Three.
Use for source-visible TOPIC AREA labels that organize units within a grade.
Use for source-visible SUB-TOPIC AREA labels that organize units below a topic area.

Use for source-visible unit headings, including the unit number and title. Preserve the full visible title, for example 'Unit 1: Numbers from 1 to 5'. Do not treat the unit number alone as an official standard code.

statement_type_policy.description: Use only for numbered key competences listed at the end of each grade-level introduction, not for generic broad competences in the front matter.
Use for the source-visible Key Unit Competence statement inside each unit table.
Use for learning objective bullets in the Knowledge and Understanding column. Do not use for Content column bullets.
Use for learning objective bullets in the Skills column. Do not use for Learning Activities column bullets.
Use for learning objective bullets in the Attitudes and Values column. Do not use for general pedagogy or front-matter values discussion.
